held_categories.named_handoff_generic: DEFER: redundant generic handoff alternatives; no spoken player-name support exists. Do not create a separate private queue cue.
held_categories.secret_action: BLOCKED: no distinct audible announcement of private actions. Do not generate for runtime or map to Murder/Recruit/response decisions. Use the common handoff instead.
held_categories.suspicion: DEFER: no current dedicated trigger; never comment on an actual accusation or imply privileged knowledge.
held_categories.loyal_banished: DEFER: current game uses a generic banishment pool. Future use requires an explicit public role reveal equal to Loyal; exclude Pariah/unknown.
held_categories.deceiver_banished: DEFER: current game uses a generic banishment pool. Future use requires an explicit public role reveal equal to Deceiver; not a private remaining-role test.
